usedFor: Clicksign holds documents and signers, and Sangam CRM receives an opportunity through “Create Opportunity” after signing activity.

bestTemplate.name: “Document Finalized” in Clicksign, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Finalizing a document marks a stage worth tracking, and the action opens an opportunity there.

watchOut: “Document Finalized” in Clicksign fires on a manual finalize only, so documents finished another way create no opportunity.
